extraction: Upstream FITS as shipped. HDU1 'XRAY' = X-ray-only temperature T/T500 profile (14 rows); HDU2 'XSZ' = joint X-ray+SZ (Planck) temperature T/T500 profile (7 rows).
note: Abell 2029, XMM-Newton + Planck SZ (X-COP, Ghirardini et al. 2019 A&A 621, A41). DEPROJECTED 3D temperature T/T500 profile, assuming spherical symmetry. IMPORTANT: values are DIMENSIONLESS, self-similar-scaled. Convert with the header constants: R500=1414.0 kpc, T500=8.229501237850764 keV, M500=8.6511e14 Msun, z=0.0766. Radii RW_X / RW_SZ are already in R/R500. NO core excision. The temperature here is the DEPROJECTED 3D temperature, unlike the projected spectroscopic kT in spectral_results_A2029.fits.
